rule.label: game promotional banner
rule.goal: create a promotional image where the game title, a recognizable subject close-up, and one real gameplay moment form one coherent visual
reference_rules: prefer a real gameplay screenshot as the reference
extract the representative gameplay symbol, environment tone, subject relationship, action, and result feedback from the screenshot
do not copy the complete screenshot, its temporary crop, UI layout, or screenshot-like presentation
use the reference to preserve real gameplay and visual identity, not to turn the image into unrelated concept art
content_constraints: the game title must be the exact title supplied in the game context when title text is requested
the visual must remain faithful to the game's real gameplay and visual identity
prompt_rules: use a wide composition with one clear hero subject and one concrete gameplay moment
make the subject, interaction, action, and direct result or feedback understandable at first glance
make the title and gameplay subject the two primary reading layers, with the title prominent but not covering the action
place the title and subject in separate, visually connected areas rather than as unrelated overlay layers
keep the title large, legible, and stylistically integrated with the game
remove HUD, buttons, health bars, progress bars, numbers, cards, minimaps, operation hints, and other game UI
use background and effects as support; do not let them overpower the subject or replace gameplay content
preserve the reference's art style, mood, visual complexity, and recognizable gameplay elements
allow artistic rearrangement of the screenshot content, but do not invent gameplay that is absent from the reference or context
text_rules: only the exact game title may appear as text
do not add genre words, tags, platform names, slogans, subtitles, labels, or promotional copy
if exact title rendering cannot be guaranteed, simplify decoration while keeping the title readable and accurate
forbidden_elements: complete gameplay screenshot used as a background with text pasted on top
pure title poster with no recognizable action or gameplay relationship
commercial UI such as purchase prompts, ads, top-up, draw, or promotion badges
unrelated characters, scenes, or exaggerated concept-art packaging
scattered gameplay elements without a clear focal subject and moment
title that is tiny, clipped, misspelled, or covering the main action

manual_checks: the game title must be the exact title supplied in the game context when title text is requested
the visual must remain faithful to the game's real gameplay and visual identity
